{{Top|leg}}
The '''Thergum Pits''' were a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Essowyn]]. It was a source of contention between the nations of [[Tresycht]] and [[Yiszte]]. When [[Messert Mines Corporation]] struck a deal with Tresycht to begin [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations in the Thergum Pits, they provided equipment and security forces to help Tresycht subjugate the nation of Yiszte.
